hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: The hidden number n is strictly less than 2 to the 30th power.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Querying with a single bit mask (1 left-shifted by i) reveals if the i-th bit of n is 1.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Iterate i from 0 through 29. If commonSetBits(1 << i) returns positive, include 1 << i into the reconstructed number.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear search over 2^30 integers exceeds the query limit.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Probe each bit independently using powers of 2.
